messages:
Mika: Quick heads up — Nimbus (channel partner) wants a joint POC for tenant-level inference (EU region). They need a runbook, SSO + SCIM, bandwidth/egress estimates, and a ballpark for Dedicated pricing. Raising checklist so we can coordinate.
Laura: Got it. Procurement will ask for a monthly number + burst pricing. Also need SOC2 addendum and contract lead times.
Raj: For a 10 qps steady workload with 50 qps bursts, we should propose a small Dedicated pool + burst credits. I'll run numbers with finance. Also need to know if embeddings are quoted separately.
Dan: Security/staging notes: they require SAML-based SSO + role mapping to groups. We have an SP metadata example. Quick SP snippet:
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood.example.com/sp">
  <SPSSODescriptor>
    <AssertionConsumerService Location="https://console.redwood.com/sso/acs"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
Mika: Also confirm data residency (they insist on EU). We should flag Private/VPC option and on-prem if needed. Who's their infosec contact? We need the vendor questionnaire filled.
ops-bot: Provisioning ticket PROV-4321 created and referenced in #eng-ops. Assignee: unassigned.
Raj: For pricing rough draft: Dedicated-small commit = $16,500/mo, burst pool = $0.40 per peak-request-unit, embeddings charged at $0.002 per embedding unit. These are placeholders — I'll finalize with finance by EOD.
Laura: Procurement will want PO lead time ~30 days. Can we include an invoice cadence option (monthly vs quarterly)? Also confirm whether we support invoice-to-PO flow for channel resellers.
Dan: Blocker: their infra uses an egress NAT that rotates IPs — our IP allowlist needs static ranges. If they can't stabilize egress, we'll recommend using our VPC connector. Quick test command for their infra team:
```
curl -v https://ifconfig.io
# should return static IP we can allowlist
```
Mika: Action items: Raj — finalize pricing + draft SOW. Dan — draft tenant provisioning runbook + SAML guide. Laura — get infosec contact and procurement constraints. Meeting Friday 10am PT to align. :calendar:
Raj: On it. I'll attach a sample SOW and pricing sheet after I sync with Finance.
Laura: FYI Nimbus asked whether embeddings & reranking are bundled into Dedicated token usage or billed separately — @Raj please call this out in the pricing sheet.
Dan: Runbook snippet for tenant provisioning (will expand):
```
POST /v1/admin/tenants
{
  "name": "nimbus-eu",
  "region": "eu-central-1",
  "quota": { "qps": 50, "tokens_month": 5000000 },
  "entitlements": ["dedicated_pool", "ssso", "audit_logs"]
}
```
Mika: Good start. Also loop in legal for NDA/MSA variations (partner co-sell addendum). If they require HSM/KMS for keys, flag as potential blocker for timeline.
ops-bot: PROV-4321 assigned to @Dan — due in 3 business days. Reminder will post tomorrow.
Laura: Locking the Friday invite now and including all required attendees from Nimbus. :thumbsup:
